name: GROMO Kafka Exporter severity
description: GROMO-2572. kafka-exporter glog 레벨 글자(I/W/E/F)를 info/warning/error/critical 로 명시 매핑해 status 로 쓴다. glog 형식이 아닌 줄(연속 줄, goroutine 덤프, 미인식 레벨)은 속성이 생기지 않아 수집 시 status(stderr=error)를 유지한다. 정본: server/observability/datadog/pipelines/kafka-exporter.json

processors.name: Parse glog header: level, MMdd, time, thread, file:line
samples: E1029 00:51:27.177953       1 kafka_exporter.go:431] Cannot get current offset of topic realtime-events.DLT partition 0: kafka: client has run out of available brokers to talk to: 2 errors occurred:
F1029 03:53:59.557708       1 kafka_exporter.go:924] Error Init Kafka Client: kafka: client has run out of available brokers to talk to: dial tcp 172.18.0.10:9092: connect: connection refused
W1029 10:00:00.000001       1 kafka_exporter.go:100] synthetic warning sample for GROMO-2572

processors.name: Map glog level letter to an explicit status word
Define glog.severity as the official status of the log
